#!/bin/sh
# realmcradle-managed SCUM server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/scum/realmcradle-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/scum/realmcradle-servers/test/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/ServerSettings.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('scum.ServerPassword', join),
):
    line = key + '=' + val
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + '=') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        pass   # not in the file: left out
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-rc-scum-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/scum/SCUM/Binaries/Win64" || exit 1
exec wine ./SCUMServer.exe -log -port=7042 -MaxPlayers=16 -nobattleye -noheartbeatthread -userdir="Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\scum\\realmcradle-servers\\test\\"
